feeds.title: SABR's Baseball Cards Research Committee Blog

SABR, Society for American Baseball Research is the ultimate national body overseeing all published and ongoing research on baseball in America.

feeds.title: Nachos Grande

I tell the story of how each piece came to be so you can read about it, and so I can look back on it later.

feeds.title: The Yount Collector
feeds.description: A blog about Robin Yount and collecting Robin Yount baseball cards and memorabilia. feeds.title: Foul bunt

Follow along as I share my deepest thoughts and inhibitions, favorite card sets, and more from Baseball sport.

I'm Jon. I live in Cardiff, Wales. I collect baseball cards and set up this blog in May 2020 when I was aiming to collect 394 baseball cards of Tony Gwynn, the greatest Padre ever. I hit my target in October 2020 and have carried on. All cards shown on this blog are scanned by me from my collection.
